title: Dillards meets Target meets Dive Bar (sounds fun, right??)
content: I recently found this community and I def have been to some of these spots… especially the resorts. I’ve always had insane dreams since a little girl (35 now) on a nightly basis. Seriously, every night I fall asleep feels like inception 😅 The mall world I have recently been going to is a department store type (like dillards/kohls meets target). Lots of escalators and event spaces within it. Oh, and a dive bar with live music!!! Last night i was at the Dillards/Target. My toddlers were with me and we were looking at clothes (from limited too!!). We saw a mom and her daughter there too trying on a pink and white striped dress. We also met pair of adult sisters with their kids and they were so helpful to us; my daughter tripped on the escalator and the blonde sister caught her and helped me. So if that was you… thanks ;)
